candidate: Learn actions that reduce the effect of hidden history on future predictions.
novelty_status: Generic idea already covered by synchronization and homing strategies; no distinct new learning operator established.
baseline: Ordinary breadth-first search in the product of two unchanged author-learned simulator states; only planned, not executed.

actual_result.root_cause: Unresolved; no claim that a particular game-version, adapter, or archive component caused the difference.

source_scope: Native game downloaded from a public mirror. Author archive and learned program are public in-sample artifacts. Native hidden state was not inspected or supplied to a learner.
decision: Preserve the mismatch and stop the planned synchronization comparison. Do not relax scene equality or treat this as method failure. Requires compatible replay before any native paired-state conclusion.

direct_prior.title: Reinforcement Learning in POMDPs Without Resets
direct_prior.finding: Section 3 defines an action-based approximate reset strategy that contracts dependence on starting beliefs. Generic action-based removal of history dependence is therefore not a new concept.
